argv:
set -eu
echo 'SECTION meta'
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'uptime='; cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/uptime
echo 'SECTION battery'; cat /sys/class/power_supply/sm5714-battery/uevent
echo 'SECTION usb'; cat /sys/class/power_supply/sm5714-usb/uevent
echo 'SECTION tcpm'; cat /sys/class/power_supply/tcpm-source-psy-3-0033/uevent
echo 'SECTION typec'
for f in power_role data_role power_operation_mode; do
    printf '%s=' "$f"; cat "/sys/class/typec/port0/$f"
done

echo @@passive; cat /sys/class/power_supply/sm5440-passive/uevent
echo @@failed; systemctl --failed --plain --no-legend --no-pager

echo @@kernel; journalctl -b -k --no-pager -o json --show-cursor --after-cursor='s=0e9cc8651fa34ae5875adb1b7f906071;i=bf18f;b=18bce160ddda4c5b9f27f8429f204b59;m=c72fe369;t=65cb06ead30af;x=bd3bebe6afb11be1'
